LanguageData.BOR_Turret_Pacifier_TIII.label: pacifier suppression turret
LanguageData.BOR_Turret_Pacifier_TIII.description: A compact tenebral suppression turret for close perimeter denial. It lashes nearby targets with concentrated neural agony, dropping them through pain and shock instead of tearing them apart.
LanguageData.BOR_Turret_Pacifier_TIII_Gun.label: pacifier emitter assembly
LanguageData.BOR_Turret_Pacifier_TIII_Gun.description: A short-range neural disruption emitter built into the pacifier turret. It dumps crippling pain into soft targets with almost no audible signature.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_Pacifier_TIII.label: pacifier pulse
